evidence_scope: Studio scalar timeline state, visible scalar table rows and mixed scalar/combined Dopesheet actions. The broader Composer goal remains active.
tested_behavior: Distinct full-identity combined, X and Y rows at the same socket and clock retain explicit axis selectors through selection, clipboard copy, popup move/paste, and history.
Capture keys and axis selectors atomically. Refused invalid-selector or byte-budget captures preserve the previous clipboard and staged originals.

A real eight-column headless ImGui table deletes a captured alias Y key through its measured Delete button. Canonical owner and alias projections change together while X and combined keys are preserved.
Return immediately after table publication invalidates borrowed keys. A refused edit or undo-history admission leaves the document unchanged and allows retry.
Project scalar pins through the source-writer capture envelope and refuse stale full payloads. Dopesheet actions and deletion retain axis selectors through history publication.
Reverse treats combined, X and Y as distinct channels. Mixed alias actions preserve singleton channels, move multi-key channels, and publish exact component selections.
Undo and redo recover exact documents. A rejected metadata cardinality clears Prepared before any later selection publication.
A scalar clipboard explicitly refuses a vector property paste target until a component target is available.
Use column-scoped selectable hitboxes so row selection and later-column controls retain ordinary independent click behavior.
